nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.description: Warning that this Next.js version may have breaking changes and agents should read the guide in node_modules before writing code.

nodes.label: Karpathy Coding Guidelines
nodes.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, authored by Andrej Karpathy.

nodes.label: Think Before Coding
nodes.description: Guideline: state assumptions explicitly, surface tradeoffs, ask when uncertain before implementing.

nodes.label: Simplicity First
nodes.description: Guideline: write minimum code that solves the problem, no speculative features or premature abstractions.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes
nodes.description: Guideline: touch only what is necessary, match existing style, and remove only orphans created by your own changes.

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution
nodes.description: Guideline: transform tasks into verifiable goals and loop until success criteria are met.

nodes.label: Frontend Architect Principles
nodes.description: High-agency principles for production-quality frontend decisions on the MyBestConsultant project.

nodes.label: Server Components by Default
nodes.description: Only add 'use client' when state, events, or browser APIs are needed; fetch in Server Components.

nodes.label: CSS Variables over Tailwind Tokens
nodes.description: Use CSS variables for all themeable values (colors, fonts, radius, shadows) instead of Tailwind tokens.

nodes.label: Forms via Server Actions
nodes.description: No client-side fetch for mutations; use useTransition + server action pattern.

nodes.label: TypeScript Strict Mode
nodes.description: No 'any', no non-null assertions without comment; use union types for variants, interface for external shapes.

nodes.label: MyBestConsultant Design System
nodes.description: Brand identity: Navy #0B1D51 + Gold #B8860B; weight inversion H1=300/H2=700; no glassmorphism; consulting-grade precision.

nodes.label: Appwrite Integration Rules
nodes.description: Self-hosted Appwrite 1.7.4 rules: no underscores in labels, node-appwrite v15, mbc-session cookie, admin client for mutations, 16-attribute limit.
